'''Eekar Oki''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Oki and several other Jedi viewed a [[Hologram/Legends|transmission]] from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] showing his [[Torture/Legends|torture]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]]. The Mon Calamari Jedi was later present during the vote for the [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|Republic financial reform bill]], the return of a group of Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] from their [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]], and [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims/Legends|the funeral]] for the victims of the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|Bombing of the Jedi Temple Hangar]].

==Biography==
[[File:Eekar_Oki.png|thumb|left|180px|Oki in the Jedi Temple during the meeting about Grievous's transmission]]
Eekar Oki, a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], served as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Episode Guide Grievous Intrigue">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode209.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|captured]] [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] near the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]].<ref name="FF-2014 21">{{FactFile2014|21|21 BBY 3-6|Intrigues in the Outer Rim}}</ref> Oki and several other Jedi were present in the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Jedi Temple communication center]] when Grievous sent a [[holograph]]ic [[Hologram/Legends|transmission]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The transmission showed Koth being [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] General.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

Later during the war,<ref name="Episode Guide Heroes on Both Sides">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode310.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] voted to [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|deregulate]] the Republic's banks, and, following the vote, Oki spoke with fellow Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] inside the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on Coruscant.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> The Mon Calamari Jedi was also present when Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]], [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived on Coruscant after they were rescued by a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] from [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] on the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]].<ref name="Wookiee Hunt">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>

When the Jedi Temple's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|was bombed]] by an [[Barriss Offee/Legends|unknown assailant]], Oki&mdash;along with many other Jedi, [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and Republic personnel&mdash;attended [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims/Legends|the funeral of the Jedi]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the event.<ref name="TJWKTM">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Oki had [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eekar Oki first appeared in "[[Grievous Intrigue]]," an episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, as a background character. Oki was identified by name in the episode's [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|corresponding guide]] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Episode Guide Grievous Intrigue" />
